nodes.name: Entry
nodes.notes: Tool fields: suchtext, richtung, frage, einreihen.

nodes.name: Direction?
nodes.notes: Yes = mood/genre/decade -> fetch suggestions and play the first one.

nodes.name: Search direction
nodes.notes: Catalogue service by mood, genre or decade.

nodes.name: Prepare suggestions
nodes.notes: Turns the suggestions into a first track or a list.

nodes.name: Status only?
nodes.notes: Yes = question about the programme, no search.

nodes.name: NowPlaying
nodes.notes: What is playing, what comes next, how many listeners.

nodes.name: Prepare status
nodes.notes: Phrases the state as text (the tool's return value).

nodes.name: Smart search
nodes.notes: Fuzzy search in the catalogue service (typo tolerant).

nodes.name: Station search
nodes.notes: Station full-text search as a second source.

nodes.name: Prepare hits
nodes.notes: Combines hits from both sources into a short list.

nodes.name: Hits present?
nodes.notes: Yes = there is a track that should play.

nodes.name: Queue it?
nodes.notes: Yes = only queue it, do not interrupt.

nodes.name: Insert now
nodes.notes: Inserts the track into the interrupting queue right away.

nodes.name: Insert after
nodes.notes: Appends the track after the current one.

nodes.name: Result
nodes.notes: Output node: the tool workflow ends here.

nodes.name: Configuration
nodes.notes: All addresses, keys and task texts (Configuration workflow).

parameters.content:
## Switches
Direction, state or title search - one of three.

## Branch: direction
Mood, genre or decade from the catalogue service.

## Branch: title search
Catalogue service (fuzzy) and the station's full-text search.

## Branch: what's playing
Only the state - the return value is the text.

## Playback
Without a path nothing is inserted - then it stays a selection list.
With a path: first clear the interrupting queue, then insert now or at the back.

## Output
The tool workflow ends here - the text goes back to the agent.

## Tool - Radio
Sub-interface of the agent for music: switches, title search, direction, state, playback.
It is called through the agent's tool nodes (Tool title search etc.).
The plan is the source: radio/tools/agent-wf-build.py (W_ANORDNUNG, W_BEREICHE).
Change/check like the agent; description: ARCHITEKTUR.md, FAEHIGKEITEN.md, APPENDIX/n8n-interface.html
